questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: The heat required to raise the temperature of body by 1 K is called :
questions.explanation: The heat required to raise the temperature of body by <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="3.143ex" height="1.545ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -683 1389 683" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mn"><use data-c="31" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-31"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(500,0)"><use data-c="1D43E" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D43E"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> is called thermal capacity or heat capacity.
